description: Verify that a named 1Password secret can be read server-side — WITHOUT returning its value. Required: reference in the form op://<vault>/<item>/<field>. Returns only whether it resolved, its length and a rough shape. Use it to confirm a credential is in place before a server-side flow relies on it. There is deliberately no tool that returns the value: flows that need it resolve it internally.
name: check_onepassword_secret
